lines.text: At Gethsemane, Jesus takes Peter, James, and John with Him and asks them to stay and keep watch.
Jesus falls to the ground and prays that the Father would take the cup from Him, yet not His own will.
Jesus returns to the disciples three times and finds them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.
Judas arrives with a crowd armed with swords and clubs, greets Jesus with "Rabbi!" and betrays Him with a handshake.
Everyone deserted Jesus and fled, and a young man pulled free of his linen cloth and ran away naked.
